notes.title: May 2021 changes
notes.notes:
May 2021 changes


 added sound about new connected player
 added sounds of construction interface
 added victory and defeat sound
 added another cargo crab death animation
 added a slider to adjust the speed of the game
 added pause for "pause" button on keyboard
 added research techs to opening buildings such as: minigun, lasergun, thunder,  rocket launcher, artillery. and prices have been changed and colors added in order of importance.
 bugfix, now credits only appear in the main menu
 bugfix, Sometimes the enemies got stuck due to an error in building a route, I could not track the error, but I made the route rebuild every 10 seconds, it fixes the problem with getting stuck.
 bugfix, when, when trying to build some buildings, the building was destroyed and not built.
 now when the camera moves, depending on the speed of movement, the wind sound becomes louder
 Now, when a player was connecting to the server, the main game user interface is not visible on the sides


At the moment I am looking for a publisher for the game, if I can find it, it will mean that the daily online users will be much higher, I can and will be developing the game longer, it is very likely that I will have to change some things in the game that the publisher will require, but I will try to find a publisher that will agree to advertise for a percentage of sales and not interfere with the development on gameplay.

In the near future I will add a translation into the languages of the countries in which this game is most often sold.

notes.title: April 2021 changes
notes.notes:
April 2021 changes


 Reworked server connection, now the connection is made through the steam and there is no need to open ports for the server to be available to the client
 added automatic update of the server list
 if the server was found, in the connect list, you will hear a beep
 added more animations of people in the main menu
 added thanks to sponsors in the main menu


The game has been in development for exactly one year. there are not many updates this month as I am very tired and needed to rest. 
I will continue development until mid-summer, most likely I will fix network problems that still exist, and after the game will be released from early access. I will add a translation into other languages, add several new studies that allow you to unlock weapons that are currently available but are not effective in the initial stages of the game. I will also try to add time acceleration, as I feel the need for it. 
I am very glad that this game has good reviews, thank you for that.

I really want to start developing the following game projects. I have a few ideas that I have not yet seen in other games.

notes.title: March 2021 changes
notes.notes:
Changes for March 2021

 Added thunder, which is the next stage of the lasergun
 Added artillery, which is the next stage of the turret
 Added a new effect, stun
 Added a note in connecting about a possible port problem connecting to the server
 Added a note about the need to open port 7007 to the server when creating a game by the server
 Added base voice to main menu
 Fixed a bug with the absence of falling dust from the ceiling in the main menu.
 Fixed the texture of the armor of the central person in the main menu.
 Fixed the texture of hand at the fold of the right person in the main menu.
 Сhanged area damage mechanics. Now, the more improvements the weapon has, the more targets it can simultaneously hit with area damage.
 Changed the appearance of the main menu buttons
 Changed the appearance of the exit menu
 Rockets damage area increased from 2 to 3


The game's price has been increased by $1 as it has undergone many improvements since its release in Early Access. the cost will also increase with the release of the game from Early Access, but there is still a lot of work ahead of that.

Most of the work was done on adding the stun effect for the laser turret and calculations for the flight of the artillery projectile. in April, most likely there will be no new weapons, instead there will be a lot of fixes to make the current game more enjoyable and understandable for beginners.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: February changes
notes.notes:
Added new gun: Pillbox
 Added 2 buildings to filter passing enemies: hedgehog, corridor. in order for this to be possible, the movement code of the enemies had to be changed. errors are possible. will be fixed in the future. now a separate route is created for each type of enemy.
 Added tv, robotic chair and table for the base interior
 Bugfix. migrated to the new network library "mirror" from library "unet". this allowed to eliminate a number of problems, including a bug when the map during the game began to be replaced by the one that was in the previous game, and made the normal game process impossible. mainly in February there was work on bugs that appeared as a result of this network change.
 Bugfix, fixed display of hints. now if a hint appears, it will not disappear if you start moving your mouse.
 Now enemies move with some displacement relative to the center of the cells.

notes.title: January 2021 changes
notes.notes:
Changes for January 2021

 Added a health scale
 Added a flashing base damage indicator
 Added rocket launcher
 Added background interior, the one that appears if you take damage or move far from the main battle map.
 Added an indicator of the estimated position of the base on the map, when choosing a map seed.
 Added seed search among verified
 Added sound of second hand when it is possible to escape.

 Now, when generating a route on the map, if the route gets to a dead end, it tries to cut through the exit. Now making a bad route with a random seed is less likely.
 Now the rocket in base is moving in UI
 Now you can build with the number buttons on the keyboard
 Now the base blows smoke if there is very little health
 Now your buildings are displayed on the map

 looking control has been changed from mouse wheel to right mouse button.
 bug fix: the construction buttons panel can no longer be moved with the mouse.
 bug fix: when the score of the previous round was summed up with the current one
 removed test red pixel on the map when injecting seed
 fixed a bug when the lasergun fired with fixed damage at any distance, now the closer the target, the more damage.
 increased damage for minigun but decreased accuracy
 fixed critical error when the current map was gradually replaced by the previous one during the game. Unfortunately, this led to other problems, but not so critical.
 increased camera speed to move with wasd buttons

These are the most significant changes in January.

what's next?
in February, I will try to add floor traps which I didn't manage to add in January. I'll add more sounds: upgrades, damage, bullet collisions, etc. I will try to make models of objects for the interior background. make more animations for robots.
as before, I ask you to tell me about bugs found, in a dedicated theme in the game community.
Thanks for playing.

notes.title: December 2020 changes
notes.notes:
Changes in the last 2 weeks since Early Access started:

 Added sphere showing firing range
 Added recharge indicator
 Added new images for animation in the main menu.
 Added more info text which appears on mouseover.
 Added a scene for loading the game, with the developer logo, This also fixes the issue of missing text on first launch as this scene takes over that error.
 Added a new parameter for towers, now the towers waits little longer to produce the fire when the target angle is minimal. This allows you to make more accurate shots when a target suddenly appears. Also this parameter increases from accuracy research.
 Now ships appear one minute early.
 Fixed bug when the maximum number of researches seems to be 13 instead of 15.
 Increased cost of upgrades of 3 levels. This makes it necessary to improve the turrets more intelligently in the later stages.
 Now, in the later stages of the game, enemies will spawn more often.


What's next?
In January, it is planned to introduce a new rocket turret that will fire self-guided missiles.
Add a new type of seed selection to cards that have previously been played by someone. This will allow you to play on already proven maps, where the generation was successful, in addition, players will be able to compete on maps.
Add a new type of traps that enemies can move on.
These are the main goals that I will try to solve this month.

If you find a bug, please report it to the community. I will solve your problems after completing the basic tasks for this month. Updates will also be released as they become available. 
Thanks for playing.
